description: This file defines the ViewsSelection class, a Drupal plugin for entity reference selection based on views. It includes methods for configuration, initializing views, fetching referenceable entities, and rendering results, specifically tailored for Drupal's Views module integration.

classes.name: ViewsSelection
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class implementing entity reference selection using views, allowing configuration and retrieval of entities based on view displays.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the plugin with services and configuration.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the plugin.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for selecting views and arguments.

methods.name: initializeView
methods.description: Initializes a view based on stored configuration, setting display and options.

methods.name: getReferenceableEntities
methods.description: Returns entities that can be referenced, based on the current view execution.

methods.name: getDisplayExecutionResults
methods.description: Executes the view display and returns results.

methods.name: stripAdminAndAnchorTagsFromResults
methods.description: Removes admin and anchor tags from view results for safe display.

methods.name: countReferenceableEntities
methods.description: Counts the number of referenceable entities.

methods.name: validateReferenceableEntities
methods.description: Validates a list of entity IDs against the view results.

methods.name: settingsFormValidate
methods.description: Static method to validate the view selection form input.
